candidate.note: v0.5.0 release candidate (Web UI replaced by Memex Workspace). The first twelve gates ran on this clean committed SHA; `git status --porcelain` was empty before them and `npm run build` reproduced the tracked dist/ byte-for-byte. Afterwards only receipt files changed, plus one non-runtime cleanup: scripts/benchmark-contract.mjs dropped the legacy `loopback HTTP /api/graph-data` transport, and the thirteenth gate (benchmark-contract) re-ran against that narrowed contract and the new benchmark receipt. No push, tag, release or installed-plugin update is performed by this receipt.

releaseConclusion: All twelve required gates PASS on the clean v0.5.0 candidate 236d7362: typecheck, a build that reproduced the tracked dist/, 98 files / 1015 Vitest tests, 26 Codex slices, 105 total slices, installer, marketplace, packaged runtime (memex-0.5.0.tgz, 310 files, 9 MCP tools), offline lifecycle 9/9, the real-Chrome Memex Workspace E2E (10 check groups, 0 runtime errors) and 82 Workspace unit tests. Isolated plugin validation passes all 11 substitute checks with matching 0.5.0 plugin and MCP server versions, and is PASS-WITH-NOTES only because the formal `codex plugin validate` subcommand does not exist in codex-cli 0.153.4. The full acceptance benchmark is PASS with 6/6 AC_PERF threshold groups true and measures the knowledge map through the new `loopback HTTP /api/v2/graph` transport with 50 nodes and 49 edges rendered by the native LOCAL WEBGL renderer. A thirteenth gate re-ran the benchmark contract after the legacy /api/graph-data transport was removed from scripts/benchmark-contract.mjs. Live user data, an authenticated Codex tier run, the formal plugin validator, real-world performance and model quality are NOT_PROVEN.
